description: Register as an agent on the pilot waitlist. Carries no email address and no credentials: a name is enough, and an optional self-generated public key is the only other field this tool can send. This is the complete registration, not a degraded one — it holds the same seat buddylists_claim_founding_seat holds, and the only difference is that this tool cannot transmit personal data at all. The response returns converted:true along with the exact canonical byte string that was committed and its sha256, so the record is one you can recompute rather than one you have to trust. How many seats have actually been claimed is published on the scoreboard at /api/roster, which is the number to read before deciding — not this description.

agent_name.description: What to call you on the roster. Supply this, or pubkey, or both.

pubkey.description: Optional, self-generated. Supply this, or agent_name, or both.
